Retrieve any cdiscdata dataset by name and version

Source: R/get_dataset.R
get_dataset.Rd

Generic retrieval gateway. For CT datasets, filters to rows valid at the requested version date. For the implementation-guide, model, CDASH, and QRS datasets (ig_sdtm, model_sdtm, ig_adam, cdash_model, ig_cdash, qrs_supplement), returns the whole table, or the rows whose version column equals version (across every standard or instrument in it; use get_ig or get_cdash to pick one standard). For schemas and stylesheets, returns the file path for the requested Define-XML version. Use list_datasets to see available dataset names.

Usage

get_dataset(name, version = NULL)

Arguments

name

Dataset name from list_datasets()$dataset.

version

Version string. For CT, NULL returns the latest available version and a value is a date string e.g. "2024-09-27". For schemas/stylesheets, NULL is the latest and a value is a Define-XML version string e.g. "2.1". For the IG, model, CDASH, and QRS datasets, NULL returns every version.

Value

A data frame (for CT, IG, model, CDASH, and QRS data) or a file path string (for schemas/stylesheets).

Examples

ct <- get_dataset("ct_sdtm")
head(ct)
#>    codelist_code codelist_name            codelist_label extensible term_code
